not_covered: real workers behind the UI (admission pending)
scope: synthetic walkthrough through the built app (node serve.js on loopback, ORIGIN set) against a live web_api server; stub workers under the test-only admission seam; synthetic baseline run (13 s, 16 kHz mono f32)
steps: GET /sources/{id}/capture?run=<baseline>: native timeline shown, interval empty (data-interval-empty=true)
POST ?/measure 5.5-6.4 s: measurement panel rendered; no record written
POST ?/save 1.0-2.0 s as reviewed_candidate: refused setup_interval_unacknowledged
POST ?/save 5.5-6.4 s: review saved (rev_ id shown)
GET /sources/{id}/process: FULLER option enabled only after the saved review
POST ?/author preset fuller + review: capture_profile job queued -> succeeded (authored_unrendered)
POST ?/author preset custom with reduction_db 50: refused invalid_parameters (not clamped)
POST ?/apply with the authored job: apply_capture_profile job queued -> succeeded
GET process: span audition block present, data-level-matched=false
GET overview: probe summary and processing job rows present
without_origin: capture and process pages render data-origin-warning and form POSTs would be refused 403 by SvelteKit (verified: the first walkthrough attempt without ORIGIN returned 403)
